text_copy_copy_copy.text: SPECIFICATION OVERVIEW

text_652839079.text:
Ankle fractures are the most common intra-articular fracture of a weight-bearing joint.1 These injuries present in a multitude of classifications and degrees of severity. The Ortholoc 3Di Ankle Fracture System combines a complete selection of indication specific implants and instruments with an advanced and versatile locking plate technology, providing a comprehensive single tray solution to these complex indications.

 

Key features

  • Single tray total indication solution eliminates the need for multiple trays in the operating room
  • Eight screw options universally compatible with all plate screw holes for unsurpassed surgical versatility
  • Pre-contoured, low-profile plate geometries and anatomic screw trajectories increase surgical speed and accuracy

text_652839079_copy_.text: The Ortholoc 3Di Ankle Fracture System offers various plates indicated for ankle fractures. This plating system includes a Lateral Fibula Plate, Posterior Fibula Plate, Syndesmosis Plate, Medial Malleolar Plate, Straight Plate, 1/3 Tubular Plate, Anterior Tibia Delta Plate, Anterolateral Tibia Plate, Medial Tibia Plate, and Posterior Tibia Plate.
